column1: #mapping_set_description: Rows of top_level_region inside the REST /info/assembly/:species response; one record per toplevel sequence of the primary assembly (no alt/patch scaffolds, no LRGs). synonyms present only with ?synonyms=1.

column9: Value transformed (rekey). Lossy: Ensembl external_db names become refmeta namespaces (RefSeq_genomic -> refseq). No INSDC synonym exists when the Ensembl name already is the accession. One served RefSeq synonym is the text 'na' (KI270721.1); it passes through.
chromosome or scaffold: Ensembl's coordinate system, not a sequence role.
